in_sanskrit.name: अर्जुन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Arjay could be derived from the Sanskrit name Arjun, which means bright, radiant, or shining. In Hindu mythology, Arjun is a renowned warrior and the greatest archer in the Mahabharata epic.

in_hindi.name: अर्जुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Arjay can be derived from the Hindi names Arjit (victorious) and An (breath). The combination of these two names may mean 'victorious breath' or 'breath of the victor'.

in_tamil.name: அர்ஜன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Arjay could be derived from the Tamil word for radiant or shining, which is அர்ஜன். This name has a similar meaning to the Sanskrit name Arjun.

in_telugu.name: అర్జున్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Arjay could be derived from the Telugu word for radiant or shining, which is అర్జున్. This name has a similar meaning to the Sanskrit name Arjun.

in_marathi.name: Arjay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Arjuna’, which means ‘pure’, ‘just’, or ‘unconquered’. Arjay signifies the victory or success of Arjuna, a great warrior from the Indian epic Mahabharata.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Arjuna's Victory
